design: Round 0 is the frozen ingested graph G0: every edge at cost 1.0, no Mend has run. For each seed, load G0, then answer every held-out question read-only and score it. Correct means the returned answer set equals gold exactly (DECISIONS 2026-11-14, C3a): a multi-answer template returns every entity tied at minimum cost, a single-answer template refuses a tie. set_f1 is the mean per-question F1 of answer set against gold. Held-out questions are never used to change the graph. This is the baseline the Mend has to beat, not a result about the Mend. Rows marked superseded are earlier measurements kept on record, with the reason they no longer stand.

rows.superseded_by: the C3a rule recorded in DECISIONS on 2026-11-14
rows.superseded_reason: Measured at commit 2a09c64, when every tie refused as ambiguous_answer. At round 0 every edge costs 1.0, so all 31 refusals were multi-answer templates whose gold is a set and whose answers were therefore tied by construction. That figure measured the tie-break rule, not the graph. Kept on record rather than deleted.
